name: WhichTrim Vehicle Data API
description:
One record per nameplate-year for every car, truck and SUV sold in the U.S. (model years 2016–2027), joined from
public-domain federal sources and manufacturers' official press kits:

* **EPA** fueleconomy.gov certification records — every configuration, MPG/MPGe, range, charge time, motor, class
* **NHTSA** recall campaigns with severity, `park_outside` / `do_not_drive` flags and remedy text
* **NHTSA** owner-complaint aggregates (counts, crash/fire/injury tallies, top components, recent excerpts)
* **NHTSA** defect investigations and NCAP 5-Star crash ratings
* **Manufacturer press kits** — trims, MSRP, specifications and standard/optional equipment where published
* a **Safety Signal grade (A–F) and score** per model-year derived from the recall record

Identifiers: `<year>_<make>_<model>` (e.g. `2026_kia_sportage`). Trim ids are prefixed with the vehicle id.
Attribution ("Data: WhichTrim, from EPA and NHTSA public records") is required on the Free plan.
